Green Environment Youth Korea (GEYK) is a nonprofit youth organization that responds to the global climate crisis and works to create a sustainable future.

Our vision is to end the climate crisis in our generation. We make policy proposals, run campaigns, work with Korean and international networks to organize events, publish media such as newsletters, attend UN climate conferences, and hold follow-up events.

We’re seeking cohort 23 members to help find ways to tackle the climate crisis and build a sustainable future with GEYK.

Recruitment Schedule

  • Applications: Friday, August 22 to Friday, August 29, 2025.
  • Shortlisted applicants notified: Saturday, August 30, individually.
  • Interviews: Sunday, August 31 to Wednesday, September 3. We will try to arrange a convenient time with shortlisted applicants, but may need to assign a slot.
  • Final decisions: Thursday, September 4.
  • New member orientation: Saturday, September 6, at 10 a.m. in Seoul. The venue will be announced later. Attendance is required to retain your place.

How to Apply

  1. Download and complete the GEYK Cohort 23 application form.
  2. Complete the Google Form.

Questions

For recruitment questions, send us a message on Instagram (@geykkorea) or email geykkorea@gmail.com.
